difficulty_reason: Two evaluations of a deliberately selected nested conjugation couple all three cyclic squaring relators to obtain ab=c^-11; feedback through c-on-a conjugation yields b=a^(2^11-1) and forces generator collapse. The unhinted coupled elimination is the nonroutine H2 burden. Root actual original-page review and one independent chain review confirm completeness; length/course label is not the basis.
statement_scope: Only the fixed presentation <a,b,c | a b a^-1=b^2, b c b^-1=c^2, c a c^-1=a^2> defines the trivial group. This item has no parametern and needs no protected principal-sheet convention.

statement_spans.label: SectionC Q11 introductory sentence asks to show the listed presentation is of the trivial group; take only item(i), the final three-relator presentation on p3. Do not include C10 or Q11(ii/iii).

proof_spans.label: Start at Solution,itemi) We note that we have the relations. Retain all original displayed conjugation equalities, including ab=c^-11 and b=a^(2^11-1). Stop after But then aba^-1=b^2 implies b=1,c=1,a=1, immediately before ii) Using aba=bab.
